intro.title: Design Real-Time Dashboard
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a real-time dashboard that displays live data updates in a React application. You'll learn how to use React hooks like useState and useEffect to manage and update dashboard data dynamically. The main technologies involved are React components, TypeScript for type safety, and simulated real-time data fetching. By the end, you'll have a functional dashboard that automatically refreshes with new information, giving you hands-on experience with reactive UI development.
intro.usecase: Real-time dashboards are essential in modern applications where live data monitoring is critical. Product examples include financial trading platforms that display constantly updating stock prices, logistics tracking systems showing live shipment locations, and server monitoring tools visualizing current system performance metrics. As a developer, you'll implement these patterns when building analytics dashboards for business intelligence, IoT device control panels, or live sports scoreboards. These interfaces require efficient data streaming, responsive visualizations, and intuitive layouts that help users make timely decisions based on current information.
